name: Landing shows a real photographic/generated hero image, not a flat fill or SVG
description: Landing shows a real photographic/generated hero image, not a flat fill or SVG.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and inspect the top hero area

Verify the hero is a real raster image (an or CSS background-image pointing at a bundled .jpg/.png/.webp with naturalWidth>0), depicting football/World-Cup key art — NOT a flat background color, a CSS gradient, an emoji collage, or an inline hand-drawn SVG. A flat/gradient/SVG-only hero fails.
